summary.repair_iteration_note: Repair-28 resolves the actionable Codex review findings on memory-rule statement validation and wildcard scope typo guarding, and keeps the provider-grant contract coherent by executing existing relia-config schema conditionals.

Wildcard scope paths now require a full current-tree or git-history path match; an existing literal prefix no longer satisfies unmatched globs such as cmd/relia/*.py.
Config schema validation now evaluates existing allOf and anyOf fragments, including required fields used by the model_provider_endpoint grant conditionals.
